items.reason: A low-strength 2.5% wash that cleanses oily skin and is gentle enough for a first routine at 16.
A light barrier moisturizer to keep skin comfortable and balanced after cleansing.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection that suits a simple morning routine.

response.routine_note: Wash with LL-103 once a day at first, building to twice if skin feels comfortable, then moisturize and wear SPF every morning. If the spots are painful, leave marks, or don't improve after 8 to 12 weeks, please see a doctor or dermatologist instead of adding more products.
